scenario: 内联代码补全(像 Copilot)要在端到端 sub-200ms 内出建议；400ms 会让开发者一天内就把它关掉，80ms 但不相关又会侵蚀信任。
scenario_en: Inline code completion (like Copilot) must return within sub-200ms end to end; 400ms makes developers disable it within a day, while 80ms but irrelevant erodes trust.
q: 在这个延迟预算下要做哪三个核心决策，为什么延迟这么关键？
q_en: What three core decisions must you make under this budget, and why is latency so critical?
why: 三个决策：选基座模型、定上下文窗口大小、用检索增强。延迟是产品生死线——太慢(400ms)开发者直接禁用，快但不相关(80ms)又不被信任，所以每个决策都要在 sub-200ms 预算内做量化取舍。
why_en: Three decisions: pick a base model, size the context window, and augment with retrieval; latency is a product life-or-death line — too slow (400ms) and developers disable it, fast but irrelevant (80ms) and it isn't trusted — so each decision is a quantified trade-off within sub-200ms.
diagram:
flowchart LR IDE["IDE 光标上下文"] --> RET["检索
编码/查询/重排"] --> ASM["上下文装配
FIM+片段"] --> M["量化模型
prefill+decode"] --> R["<200ms 返回建议"]
options: 只需选参数量最大的模型：pass@1 全场最高，哪怕延迟慢个几百毫秒开发者也能接受
只需把上下文窗口开到 32K，塞进整个仓库代码，模型自己会挑相关的
三决策：基座模型/上下文窗口/检索增强，三者共享同一份 sub-200ms 预算
延迟不是设计变量，开发者愿意多等几百毫秒换一条更准的建议
options_en: Just pick the largest model: it has the best pass@1 across the board, and developers can live with it even if latency is a few hundred milliseconds slower.
Just open the context window to 32K and stuff the whole repo in; the model will pick what matters.
Three decisions: base model / context window / retrieval, all sharing one sub-200ms budget.
Latency is not a design variable; developers will wait a few hundred more milliseconds for a better suggestion.
optionExplanations: 最大模型每 token 延迟超预算，补全太慢会被开发者一天内禁用，越大越准救不了产品。
窗口开到最大会让 prefill 延迟爆表，塞得多但来不及出建议，反而更糟。
对；模型/窗口/检索三个旋钮共享 200ms 预算，速度与相关性都要，全靠量化取舍平衡。
补全是实时交互，开发者等不了，400ms 就已经会被关掉，延迟恰恰是核心约束。
optionExplanations_en: The biggest model's per-token latency exceeds budget, so slow completion gets disabled within a day; more accuracy can't save the product.
Maxing the window explodes prefill latency, stuffing much but too late to suggest — worse.
Correct — model/window/retrieval share the 200ms budget, needing both speed and relevance, balanced by quantified trade-offs.
Completion is real-time interaction; developers won't wait, 400ms already gets it turned off, so latency is the core constraint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 填中间：给模型光标前 prefix 和光标后 suffix，补中间缺失的代码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIM (Fill-In-the-Middle) gives the model the prefix before and suffix after the cursor to complete the missing code between them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生成前把整段上下文一次性编码的阶段，成本随上下文长度快速增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prefill is the stage that encodes the whole context at once before generation, its cost rising fast with context length.

scenario: 两种失败：端到端 400ms 的补全，vs 80ms 但不相关的补全。
scenario_en: Two failure modes: a 400ms end-to-end completion, vs an 80ms but irrelevant one.
q: 这两个数字各代表什么失败模式，对设计的启示是什么？
q_en: What failure mode does each number represent, and what does it imply for design?
why: 400ms=太慢，开发者觉得卡、一天内禁用→延迟必须压进 sub-200ms；80ms 但不相关=快却没用、侵蚀信任→只压延迟不够，还要靠检索保证相关性。两个失败模式说明速度和相关性缺一不可。
why_en: 400ms = too slow, feels laggy, disabled within a day → latency must fit sub-200ms; 80ms but irrelevant = fast yet useless, eroding trust → speed alone isn't enough, retrieval must ensure relevance — both matter.
options: 两个都是纯速度问题，只要把整体响应压到 100ms 以内，两种失败模式自然都会消失
400ms=太慢被禁用；80ms 但不相关=快却没用侵蚀信任；速度与相关性都要
两个都是相关性问题，只要检索够准就行，跟响应延迟这条约束无关
这两个数字只是拿来考背诵的数值，没有能落地的设计含义
options_en: Both are pure speed problems; push overall response under 100ms and both failure modes disappear.
400ms = too slow, gets disabled; 80ms-but-irrelevant = fast yet useless and erodes trust; you need both speed and relevance.
Both are relevance problems; make retrieval accurate enough and response latency stops mattering.
These two numbers are just values to memorize, with no design meaning to act on.

termDefinitions.meaning: 补全虽快但常不相关，开发者逐渐不信任、忽略甚至关闭它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Trust erosion is when completions are fast but often irrelevant, so developers stop trusting and eventually disable them.

optionExplanations: 把两种失败都归为速度问题，会漏掉 80ms 那版其实是相关性差、不是不够快。
对；400ms 会被直接禁用要压进 <200ms，80ms 快但不相关会悄悄侵蚀信任要靠检索补，两条都要顾。
把两种失败都归为相关性，却忽略了 400ms 明明是纯延迟超预算导致被禁用。
这两个数字各自指向一种要单独解决的失败模式，不是拿来背的孤立常量。
optionExplanations_en: Chalking both up to speed misses that the 80ms version fails on relevance, not slowness.
Correct — 400ms gets disabled and must fit <200ms; 80ms is fast but irrelevant and quietly erodes trust, needing retrieval; both matter.
Chalking both up to relevance ignores that 400ms is a pure latency overrun that gets it disabled.
Each number points to a distinct failure mode to fix separately, not an isolated fact to memorize.

scenario: 选代码补全的基座模型，面试官想听你讲清权衡的几个维度。
scenario_en: Choosing a base model for code completion, the interviewer wants the trade-off axes made clear.
q: 基座模型选择的三轴权衡是哪三条？
q_en: What are the three axes of the base-model trade-off?
why: 三轴：模型大小(pass@1 vs 显存/延迟)、语言覆盖(长尾够不够)、推理延迟(能否进 sub-200ms)。三者互相牵制，为覆盖换大模型就要还延迟的债。
why_en: Three axes: model size (bigger raises HumanEval pass@1 but costs more GPU memory and per-token latency), language coverage (small models skew Python/JS while big ones cover the Go/Rust long tail at higher cost), and inference latency (1B-3B fit sub-200ms on one GPU while 13B+ exceed it without aggressive optimization) — mutually constraining.
options: 模型大小、语言覆盖(长尾语言)、推理延迟
只有模型大小一个维度，参数量越大补全越好
训练数据总量、团队人数、云厂商折扣力度
前端框架、编辑器插件配色、日志采集方案
options_en: Model size, language coverage (long-tail languages), and inference latency.
Just one axis, model size; more parameters always completes better.
Total training data volume, team headcount, and cloud vendor discounts.
Frontend framework, editor plugin colors, and log collection scheme.
optionExplanations: 对；大小、语言覆盖、推理延迟正是互相牵制的三轴，任何一轴过头都会挤爆另外两轴。
只看大小会忽略语言覆盖和延迟，大模型可能覆盖广但根本进不了预算。
团队规模/云厂商是工程组织问题，不是模型选择的技术权衡轴。
前端/配色/日志与基座模型选择无关，答非所问。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — size, language coverage, and inference latency are the three mutually constraining axes; maxing one crushes the other two.
Size-only ignores coverage and latency; a big model may cover broadly yet miss the budget entirely.
Team size/cloud vendor are org concerns, not model-selection axes.
Frontend/colors/logging are unrelated to base-model selection.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 HumanEval 代码基准上，模型一次采样就通过全部单元测试的比例，衡量功能正确性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HumanEval pass@1 is the fraction of tasks a single sampled completion passes all unit tests on the HumanEval benchmark, measuring functional correctness.

termDefinitions.meaning: 使用较少但仍需支持的语言(如 Go/Rust/Kotlin)，小模型常覆盖不好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The long tail is less-common but still-needed languages (Go/Rust/Kotlin) that small models often cover poorly.

scenario: 一边是 13B-15B(HumanEval pass@1 最高)，一边是 1B-3B(单 GPU 能进 sub-200ms)，要在实时内联补全里选。
scenario_en: One side is 13B-15B (highest HumanEval pass@1), the other 1B-3B (fits sub-200ms on one GPU), for real-time inline completion.
q: 实时补全场景更该偏大模型还是小模型，为什么？
q_en: For real-time completion, lean bigger or smaller, and why?
why: 偏小(1B-3B)：补全是延迟敏感的实时场景，1B-3B 单 GPU 能进 sub-200ms，而 13B+ 每 token 延迟和显存都超预算、不激进优化跑不进 200ms。大模型 pass@1 更高但用户等不起。
why_en: Lean small (1B-3B): completion is latency-sensitive, and 1B-3B fits sub-200ms on one GPU, whereas 13B+ blow both per-token latency and memory past budget and can't hit 200ms without aggressive optimization; the big model's higher pass@1 isn't worth the wait.
tradeoff: 大模型(pass@1 高但延迟/显存超预算) vs 小模型(进 sub-200ms 但准确率略低)
whenOtherWins: 若是离线批量代码生成(如自动化 PR、无实时延迟约束)，就该上大模型换更高 pass@1。
options: 偏 13B-15B：HumanEval pass@1 全场最高，多等一两百毫秒开发者完全能接受
偏 70B+ 通用模型，参数量越大补全一定越好
不用模型，靠语法规则模板生成补全，延迟最低
偏 1B-3B：单 GPU 就能进 sub-200ms，13B+ 每 token 延迟超预算
options_en: Lean 13B-15B: it has the best HumanEval pass@1 across the board, and developers can fully accept waiting an extra hundred milliseconds or two.
Lean 70B+ general models; more parameters always completes better.
Use no model at all; generate completions from syntax rule templates for the lowest latency.
Lean 1B-3B: fits sub-200ms on a single GPU, while 13B+ blows the per-token latency budget.
optionExplanations: 13B-15B 每 token 30-50ms，实时补全根本进不了 200ms，pass@1 再高也被禁用。
70B 延迟和显存都远超预算，实时补全完全不可行。
规则模板无法理解上下文、不能个性化补全，质量和覆盖都不够。
对；延迟敏感场景优先能进预算的小模型，大模型的准确率优势换不来用户能接受的延迟。
optionExplanations_en: 13B-15B at 30-50ms/token can't hit 200ms for real-time completion, so high pass@1 still gets disabled.
70B blows latency and memory far past budget, infeasible for real-time completion.
Rule templates can't understand context or personalize, lacking quality and coverage.
Correct — latency-sensitive settings favor a budget-fitting small model, since the big model's accuracy edge can't buy acceptable latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生成每个 token 的时间，模型越大越高，多 token 建议会成倍放大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Latency per token is the time to generate each token; larger models raise it, and multi-token suggestions multiply it.

scenario: 用户里有不少人写 Go/Rust/Kotlin 这类长尾语言，一个只在 Python/JS 上训得多的 3B 模型在这些语言上明显变差。
scenario_en: Many users write long-tail languages like Go/Rust/Kotlin, and a 3B trained mostly on Python/JS clearly degrades on them.
q: 语言覆盖这一轴该怎么权衡？
q_en: How do you weigh the language-coverage axis?
why: 一个偏 Python/JS 的 3B 在长尾语言上表现差；7B 通用模型能覆盖长尾但算力更贵、延迟更高。要按用户实际语言分布权衡：长尾语言占比高，就得为覆盖付更大模型的代价。
why_en: A Python/JS-skewed 3B does poorly on long-tail languages, while a 7B general model covers them at higher compute and latency, so weigh by the actual user language distribution: a high long-tail share means paying for a bigger model to get coverage.
tradeoff: 小模型偏主力语言(快但长尾差) vs 大通用模型(覆盖长尾但更慢更贵)
whenOtherWins: 若 80% 用户写 Python/TS，反而该选更小的代码专用模型，它在主力语言上能打过更大的通用模型，还更快。
options: 语言覆盖根本不重要，一个只在 Python 上训练的专用小模型就能覆盖所有场景走天下
小模型偏 Python/JS 长尾差；7B 通用能覆盖但更贵更慢
模型越大语言覆盖反而越差，小模型才通用
覆盖问题靠给长尾语言加正则规则解决，与选模型无关
options_en: Language coverage doesn't matter at all; a small model trained only on Python can cover every scenario and serve everyone.
A Python/JS-skewed small model is weak on the long tail; a 7B general model covers it but costs more and is slower.
Bigger models actually have worse language coverage; small models are the general ones.
Coverage is solved by adding regex rules for long-tail languages, independent of model choice.
optionExplanations: 若用户写大量 Go/Rust，Python 模型在这些语言上补全很差，覆盖显然重要。
对；覆盖长尾要更大更贵的模型，是否值得取决于长尾语言在用户里的占比。
说反了：更大的通用模型通常语言覆盖更广，不是更差。
语言的语义和惯用法要模型学，正则规则补不了长尾语言的补全能力。
optionExplanations_en: If users write lots of Go/Rust, a Python model completes them poorly, so coverage clearly matters.
Correct — covering the long tail needs a bigger, costlier model, worth it depending on the long-tail share among users.
Backwards: bigger general models usually have broader, not worse, coverage.
Language semantics and idioms must be learned by the model; regex can't supply long-tail completion ability.

termDefinitions.term: code-specialized model / 代码专用模型
termDefinitions.meaning: 主要在代码上训练/微调的模型，在编程任务上常优于同规模通用模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A code-specialized model is trained/fine-tuned mainly on code and often beats a same-size general model on programming tasks.

scenario: 面试官要你按 sub-200ms 预算比较 1B-3B / 7B / 13B-15B 三档模型。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to compare 1B-3B / 7B / 13B-15B tiers against the sub-200ms budget.
q: 三档模型在延迟、长尾覆盖、pass@1、能否进 sub-200ms 上如何对比？
q_en: How do the three tiers contrast on latency, long-tail coverage, pass@1, and fitting sub-200ms?
why: 1B-3B 最快、延迟宽裕但长尾覆盖有限；7B 折中，INT8 量化后能进预算；13B-15B pass@1 最高但每 token 30-50ms，不上推测解码就进不了 sub-200ms。取舍是准确率/覆盖 vs 延迟。
why_en: 1B-3B is fastest with slack but limited long-tail coverage; 7B is a middle ground fitting budget after INT8 quantization; 13B-15B has the highest pass@1 but 30-50ms/token, missing sub-200ms without speculative decoding — the trade is accuracy/coverage vs latency.
tradeoff: 大档(pass@1/覆盖高但延迟超预算) vs 小档(进预算但覆盖/准确率有限)
options: 三档每 token 延迟一样，差别只在 pass@1 准确率
13B-15B 每 token 延迟最低、最容易进 sub-200ms，1B-3B 反而最慢
1B-3B 最快但长尾有限；7B 量化后可行；13B-15B pass@1 最高但要推测解码
模型越大每 token 延迟越低，因为并行度更高
options_en: All three tiers have the same per-token latency; they only differ in pass@1 accuracy.
13B-15B has the lowest per-token latency and fits sub-200ms most easily, while 1B-3B is actually the slowest.
1B-3B is fastest but weak on the long tail; 7B works after quantization; 13B-15B has the best pass@1 but needs speculative decoding.
Bigger models have lower per-token latency because they parallelize better.
optionExplanations: 三档延迟差好几倍(5-10ms vs 30-50ms/token)，不是一样。
说反了：13B-15B 延迟最高、最难进预算。
对；这条对比把「越大越准但越慢」的取舍摊开，正好指导按预算选档。
越大每 token 延迟越高，不是越低。
optionExplanations_en: The tiers differ several-fold in latency (5-10ms vs 30-50ms/token), not equal.
Backwards: 13B-15B has the highest latency and hardest budget fit.
Correct — this lays out the 'bigger is more accurate but slower' trade, guiding tier choice by budget.
Bigger means higher per-token latency, not lower.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一款常见的数据中心 GPU，这里作为衡量每 token 推理延迟的参照硬件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The A100 is a common datacenter GPU, used here as the reference hardware for per-token inference latency.

scenario: 在准确率和延迟之间，你要为实时代码补全定一个基座模型的甜点区。
scenario_en: Between accuracy and latency, you must pin a base-model sweet spot for real-time code completion.
q: 代码补全基座模型的甜点区大致是什么？
q_en: What is roughly the base-model sweet spot for code completion?
why: 甜点区是 1B-7B 的代码专用模型：够小能进 sub-200ms，又因代码专用在补全上打得过更大的通用模型。再配量化和推测解码把 Pareto 前沿往前推，兼顾质量和延迟。
why_en: The sweet spot is a 1B-7B code-specialized model: small enough for sub-200ms yet, being code-specialized, it beats larger general models on completion, with quantization and speculative decoding pushing the Pareto frontier to balance quality and latency.
tradeoff: 1B-7B 代码专用(进预算又够准) vs 更大通用(更全但超延迟预算)
whenOtherWins: 若延迟约束放开(离线代码生成)，甜点区上移到更大的通用/专用模型换更高质量。
options: 1B-7B 代码专用模型：够小能进 sub-200ms，又打得过大通用模型
70B 通用模型：参数量越大，语言和框架覆盖越全
300M 以下的极小模型：延迟压到最低、体验最好，补全质量可以后面再慢慢迭代调优
不用基座模型，靠检索到的片段直接模板拼接成补全
options_en: A 1B-7B code-specialized model: small enough for sub-200ms, yet beats larger general models.
A 70B general model: more parameters means broader language and framework coverage.
A sub-300M tiny model: latency is pushed to the lowest, giving the best experience, and completion quality can be iterated on and tuned later.
No base model at all; stitch retrieved snippets into completions with templates.
optionExplanations: 对；1B-7B 代码专用兼顾进预算和质量，再用量化/推测解码把速度-质量前沿推得更好。
70B 延迟远超 200ms，实时补全不可行，覆盖再全也用不上。
极小模型虽快但质量太差，补全常不相关，会侵蚀信任。
纯模板不理解上下文、不能个性化，达不到补全质量要求。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — 1B-7B code-specialized balances budget and quality, and quantization/speculative decoding push the speed-quality frontier further.
70B far exceeds 200ms, infeasible for real-time completion however broad its coverage.
A tiny model is fast but too low-quality, often irrelevant and eroding trust.
Pure templates don't understand context or personalize, missing completion quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在速度和质量两个目标间无法再单方面改进的最优权衡边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Pareto frontier is the set of best trade-offs between speed and quality where neither can improve without hurting the other.

scenario: 一个 7B 模型质量够好，但 FP16 下每 token 延迟和显存都逼近 sub-200ms 预算上限。
scenario_en: A 7B model is good enough, but in FP16 its per-token latency and memory both push the sub-200ms limit.
q: 怎么在不换模型的前提下把 7B 压进延迟/显存预算？
q_en: How do you fit the 7B into the latency/memory budget without changing models?
why: 用量化(INT8/INT4)：把权重从 FP16 降到 INT8/INT4，显存和每 token 延迟都下降，把同一模型的 Pareto 前沿往「更快更省」推，基本保住质量。代价是过激的低比特量化可能掉一点精度。
why_en: Use quantization (INT8/INT4): drop weights from FP16 to INT8/INT4, cutting memory and per-token latency and pushing the same model's Pareto frontier toward faster/cheaper while largely preserving quality, at the cost that aggressive low-bit quantization may lose a little accuracy.
tradeoff: 量化(显存/延迟降但可能掉点精度) vs FP16(精度满但更慢更占显存)
whenOtherWins: 若模型本来就很小、延迟和显存都很宽裕，量化收益不大，还不如省掉量化带来的精度损失。
options: 直接换成 1B 模型，用质量换延迟，反正补全很短
把上下文窗口砍半，用更少上下文换更短的 prefill
量化(INT8/INT4)：降权重比特数，显存和每 token 延迟一起降
多加几张 GPU 做张量并行，靠堆更多硬件的方式把每 token 延迟继续往下压
options_en: Just swap in a 1B model, trading quality for latency since completions are short anyway.
Halve the context window, trading less context for a shorter prefill.
Quantization (INT8/INT4): lower the weight bit-width so memory and per-token latency both drop.
Add more GPUs for tensor parallelism, piling on more hardware to keep pushing per-token latency further down.
optionExplanations: 换 1B 是降一档模型、质量下滑，题目要的是保住 7B 质量还压进预算。
砍窗口会丢上下文、降补全质量，不是不换模型压延迟的正解。
对；量化在几乎保质量的前提下同时降显存和延迟，是不换模型进预算的标准手段。
加 GPU 提吞吐但单请求每 token 延迟不降，补全延迟约束靠量化而非堆卡。
optionExplanations_en: Swapping to 1B drops a tier and lowers quality; the goal is keeping 7B quality while fitting budget.
Halving the window loses context and lowers completion quality — not the fix for latency without changing models.
Correct — quantization cuts both memory and latency while largely preserving quality, the standard way to fit budget without changing models.
More GPUs raise throughput but don't cut per-request per-token latency; completion latency is fixed by quantization, not more cards.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型权重从高精度(FP16)降到低比特(INT8/INT4)，省显存降延迟，略损精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization lowers model weights from high precision (FP16) to low bits (INT8/INT4), saving memory and latency at a small accuracy cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 权重的数值精度：FP16 是 16 位浮点，INT8/INT4 是 8/4 位整数，越低越省越快。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FP16/INT8/INT4 are weight numeric precisions: 16-bit float vs 8/4-bit integer — lower is cheaper and faster.

scenario: 想要 7B 级别的补全质量，但又不想付 7B 逐 token 解码的延迟。
scenario_en: You want 7B-class completion quality without paying 7B's token-by-token decoding latency.
q: 有什么解码技巧能拿到「7B 质量、接近 3B 延迟」？
q_en: What decoding trick gives '7B quality at near-3B latency'?
why: 用推测解码(speculative decoding)：一个小 draft 模型一次提议多个 token，大模型在一次前向里并行验证这些提议、接受对的。省去逐 token 串行解码，拿到接近小模型的延迟、保住大模型的质量。
why_en: Use speculative decoding: a small draft model proposes several tokens at once, and the large model verifies them in parallel in one forward pass, accepting the correct ones — replacing serial token-by-token decoding to get near-small-model latency with large-model quality.
tradeoff: 推测解码(近小模型延迟+大模型质量但要维护 draft 模型) vs 常规逐 token 解码(简单但慢)
whenOtherWins: 若没有合适的小 draft 模型、或验证开销吃掉了收益，推测解码就不划算，直接用量化更简单。
diagram:
flowchart LR D["小 draft 模型
一次提议多 token"] --> V["大模型一次前向
并行验证"] --> A["接受正确 token"]
options: 把 7B 蒸馏成 3B，延迟降下来、质量也跟着降
推测解码：小 draft 模型提议多 token，大模型一次前向并行验证
调高采样温度，让模型更快地收敛到答案
多买几张 GPU 并行跑同一个 7B 请求，摊薄单个请求上的解码延迟开销总量
options_en: Distill the 7B into a 3B; latency drops and so does quality.
Speculative decoding: a small draft model proposes several tokens and the large model verifies them in one parallel forward pass.
Raise the sampling temperature so the model converges to an answer faster.
Buy more GPUs to run the same 7B request in parallel, amortizing the total decode-latency cost across a single request.
optionExplanations: 蒸馏成 3B 直接丢掉 7B 的质量，正是要避免的取舍。
对；draft 提议+大模型并行验证把逐 token 串行变成一次验证多 token，延迟降而质量不降。
温度只改采样随机性，不改变解码速度，与延迟无关。
多 GPU 提吞吐但不降单序列逐 token 延迟，补全延迟要靠推测解码。
optionExplanations_en: Distilling to 3B discards the 7B quality — exactly the trade to avoid.
Correct — the draft proposes and the big model verifies in parallel, turning serial per-token into one multi-token verify, cutting latency without losing quality.
Temperature only changes sampling randomness, not decoding speed, unrelated to latency.
More GPUs raise throughput but don’t cut single-sequence per-token latency; completion latency needs speculative decoding.

termDefinitions.meaning: 小 draft 模型一次提议多 token，大模型一次前向并行验证，接近小模型延迟拿大模型质量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Speculative decoding has a small draft model propose several tokens that the large model verifies in one forward pass, giving near-draft latency with large-model quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 推测解码里那个先提议候选 token 的小模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The draft model is the small model in speculative decoding that first proposes candidate tokens.

scenario: 数据显示 80% 的用户主要写 Python/TS，你在「更大的通用模型」和「更小的代码专用模型」之间选。
scenario_en: Data shows 80% of users mainly write Python/TS, and you choose between a larger general model and a smaller code-specialized one.
q: 已知用户语言高度集中，该怎么选模型？
q_en: Given a highly concentrated user language distribution, which model?
why: 选更小的代码专用模型：80% 用户集中在 Python/TS，一个在这些语言上专精的小模型能打过更大的通用模型，还更快更省。把模型对齐到用户实际语言分布，而不是盲目追求覆盖所有语言。
why_en: Pick the smaller code-specialized model: with 80% on Python/TS, a model specialized on those languages beats a larger general one, faster and cheaper — align the model to the actual user distribution rather than blindly chasing all-language coverage.
tradeoff: 小代码专用对齐主力语言(快且主力更准) vs 大通用覆盖全语言(全但慢且主力未必更强)
whenOtherWins: 若用户语言分布很分散、长尾语言占比高，就需要更大的通用模型来覆盖，不能只押主力语言。
options: 选最大的通用模型，覆盖所有语言最保险，用不上也不亏
每种语言各训练一个专用模型，按文件后缀路由
随便选，用户的语言分布跟选模型没有关系
选更小的代码专用模型：主力语言上打过大通用模型，还更快
options_en: Pick the biggest general model; covering every language is safest even if most coverage goes unused.
Train one specialized model per language and route by file extension.
Pick anything; the user language distribution has nothing to do with model choice.
Pick the smaller code-specialized model: it beats the big general model on the main languages and is faster.
optionExplanations: 80% 集中在两种语言，为覆盖用不上的长尾付大模型的延迟代价不划算。
每语言一个模型运维爆炸，且主力语言本可用一个专用模型覆盖，过度设计。
语言分布正是选型的关键依据，高度集中就该对齐主力语言。
对；把模型对齐到 80% 的主力语言，用更小更快的专用模型在这些语言上取得更高质量。
optionExplanations_en: With 80% on two languages, paying a big model's latency for unused long-tail coverage isn't worth it.
One model per language explodes ops, and the main languages fit one specialized model — over-engineering.
The distribution is exactly the selection basis; high concentration means aligning to the main languages.
Correct — align to the 80% main languages with a smaller, faster specialized model that scores higher on them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户实际使用各编程语言的占比，是选模型规模与专精方向的依据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The language distribution is the share of each programming language among users, the basis for choosing model size and specialization.

scenario: 单文件补全的准确率随上下文窗口变化：512→2048 提升明显，2048→4096 变缓，超过 4096 基本持平，而延迟一路上涨。
scenario_en: For single-file completion, accuracy improves sharply 512→2048, moderates 2048→4096, plateaus beyond 4096, while latency keeps climbing.
q: 这条「收益递减」曲线对上下文窗口设计意味着什么？
q_en: What does this diminishing-returns curve imply for context-window design?
why: 512→2048 抓到局部签名/变量，提升陡；2048→4096 抓跨函数，提升变缓；超 4096 单文件补全基本持平，但延迟(尤其 prefill)还在涨。所以生产用 2048-4096 有效窗口，再大是拿延迟换几乎为零的准确率。
why_en: 512→2048 captures local signatures/vars (sharp gain), 2048→4096 captures cross-function (moderate), and beyond 4096 single-file completion plateaus while latency (especially prefill) keeps rising — so production uses 2048-4096 effective windows, since larger trades latency for near-zero accuracy.
options: 窗口越大补全准确率就越高，且理论上完全没有上限，生产环境应该尽量把窗口开到最大
收益递减：>4096 单文件基本持平但延迟仍涨，生产用 2048-4096
窗口大小和补全准确率互不影响，调窗口只影响延迟不影响质量
这条曲线只是拿来考背诵的数字，没有能落地的设计含义
options_en: The bigger the window, the higher completion accuracy gets, with no ceiling in theory, so production should open the window as wide as possible.
Diminishing returns: past 4096 single-file accuracy plateaus while latency keeps rising, so production uses 2048-4096.
Window size and completion accuracy do not affect each other; tuning the window only changes latency, not quality.
This curve is just a number to memorize, with no design meaning to act on.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上下文越大，每增加一段带来的准确率提升越小，最终趋于持平。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Diminishing returns means each added context yields smaller accuracy gains until it plateaus.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生产中真正用来装上下文的窗口大小，权衡准确率与延迟后取值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The effective window is the context size actually used in production, chosen by trading accuracy against latency.

optionExplanations: 收益在 4096 后已持平，再开大只吃延迟、换不来准确率，"越大越好"在这里不成立。
对；收益递减曲线明确指出生产该停在 2048-4096，超过是拿延迟换几乎为零的准确率。
512→2048 提升明显说明窗口大小确实影响准确率，两者并非无关。
这条曲线直接决定了生产窗口该停在哪里，是设计取舍的依据，不是背诵项。
optionExplanations_en: Gains plateau past 4096, so opening wider only costs latency without buying accuracy — "bigger is always better" fails here.
Correct — the diminishing-returns curve says production should stop at 2048-4096; beyond that trades latency for near-zero accuracy.
The sharp 512→2048 gain shows window size clearly does affect accuracy, so they are not unrelated.
This curve directly sets where production should cap the window — a design input, not a fact to memorize.

scenario: 标准注意力下，prefill(把整段上下文一次性编码)的成本随上下文长度增长。
scenario_en: Under standard attention, prefill cost (encoding the whole context at once) grows with context length.
q: prefill 成本随上下文长度怎么增长，为什么这限制了窗口大小？
q_en: How does prefill cost grow with context length, and why does it cap window size?
why: 标准注意力里每个 token 要和其他所有 token 算注意力，prefill 成本随长度呈二次方(O(n²))增长：窗口翻倍，prefill 约翻四倍，开到 8192 会直接超出 200ms 预算。
why_en: In standard attention each token attends to every other, so prefill cost grows quadratically (O(n²)) with length: doubling the window roughly quadruples prefill, and 8192 directly exceeds the 200ms budget.
options: 线性增长：窗口翻倍 prefill 延迟也只多花一倍时间，8192 这么大依然扛得住预算
与长度无关，prefill 是个常数，只跟模型参数量有关
二次方 O(n²)：窗口翻倍 prefill 约翻四倍，8192 就超 200ms
对数增长：长度再大 prefill 的增量也几乎可以忽略不计
options_en: Linear: doubling the window only doubles prefill latency too, so even a window as large as 8192 still fits the budget.
Independent of length; prefill is a constant that depends only on parameter count.
Quadratic O(n²): doubling the window roughly quadruples prefill, so 8192 exceeds 200ms.
Logarithmic: however long the context gets, the prefill increment stays negligible.

termDefinitions.term: attention O(n²) / 注意力二次复杂度
termDefinitions.meaning: 标准注意力中每个 token 与所有 token 交互，计算量随长度平方增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Standard attention has every token interact with every other, so compute grows with the square of length.

optionExplanations: 如果是线性，窗口翻倍只翻倍延迟，8192 大概率还能挤进预算，跟实测的爆预算不符。
对；标准注意力每个 token 要和全部 token 算，prefill 随长度平方增长，翻倍窗口约翻四倍时间。
常数意味着开多大窗口 prefill 都不变，无法解释为什么窗口越大越难进 200ms。
对数增长几乎不涨，同样解释不了大窗口下 prefill 会直接撑爆预算的现象。
optionExplanations_en: If it were linear, doubling the window would only double latency and 8192 would likely still fit — that contradicts the observed budget blowout.
Correct — standard attention has each token attend to all others, so prefill grows with the square of length; doubling the window roughly quadruples time.
Constant cost would mean prefill never changes with window size, which can't explain why larger windows get harder to fit in 200ms.
Logarithmic growth stays nearly flat, which also can't explain prefill blowing the budget at large windows.

scenario: 有效窗口只有 2048-4096 token，但光标周围、打开的 tab、import 的相关代码远超这个量。
scenario_en: The effective window is only 2048-4096 tokens, but nearby code, open tabs, and imports far exceed that.
q: 窗口装不下所有相关代码，该怎么挑进窗口的 token？
q_en: When the window can't hold all relevant code, how do you pick which tokens go in?
why: 用分层上下文剪枝：从打开的 tab、import 等来源里按价值挑最高价值的 token 进窗口，而不是就近全塞。让有限窗口装的是最相关的信号，腾出空间给检索片段。
why_en: Use hierarchical context pruning: pick the highest-value tokens from open tabs, imports, and such into the window rather than dumping everything nearby, so the limited window holds the most relevant signal and leaves room for retrieved snippets.
tradeoff: 分层剪枝(装最高价值 token 但要打分选择逻辑) vs 就近全塞(简单但塞进大量低价值 token)
whenOtherWins: 若相关代码本就很少、窗口装得下，剪枝是多余复杂度，直接全放即可。
options: 就近把光标前后的代码一股脑塞满窗口，默认物理距离就等于相关度
分层上下文剪枝：从 tab/import 里按价值挑 token
随机丢掉一半 token，保证窗口不溢出且实现最简单
把窗口开到 32K 把相关文件全放进去，不用做挑选
options_en: Just dump the code right around the cursor until the window is full, assuming physical distance equals relevance.
Hierarchical context pruning: pick tokens by value from open tabs and imports.
Randomly drop half the tokens so the window never overflows and the code stays simplest.
Open the window to 32K and put every related file in, with no selection at all.
optionExplanations: 就近全塞会把大量低价值 token 塞进窗口，挤掉真正相关的信号，质量下降。
对；按价值剪枝让有限窗口装最相关的 token，还给检索片段留位置，是窗口受限下的正解。
随机丢会同时丢掉高价值 token，破坏上下文的连贯与相关性。
开到 32K 会让 prefill 二次爆炸、超出 200ms 预算，装得下也来不及。
optionExplanations_en: Dumping everything fills the window with low-value tokens, squeezing out truly relevant signal and lowering quality.
Correct — value-based pruning packs the limited window with the most relevant tokens and leaves room for retrieved snippets, the right fix under a window limit.
Random dropping also discards high-value tokens, breaking context coherence and relevance.
Opening to 32K quadratically explodes prefill past the 200ms budget — it fits but is too late.

termDefinitions.term: hierarchical context pruning / 分层上下文剪枝
termDefinitions.meaning: 从多来源(tab/import 等)按价值挑选最高价值 token 进有限窗口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hierarchical context pruning selects the highest-value tokens from sources like tabs and imports into the limited window.

scenario: 200ms 总预算拆解：网络往返(IDE↔服务)~20ms、上下文装配~10ms、prefill 60ms@2048(4096 到 100ms+)、token 解码 40-80ms。
scenario_en: 200ms budget: network round-trip (IDE↔server) ~20ms, context assembly ~10ms, prefill 60ms@2048 (100ms+@4096), token decoding 40-80ms.
q: 这份 200ms 预算拆解揭示了什么设计约束？
q_en: What design constraint does this 200ms budget breakdown reveal?
why: 各项相加@2048 约 130-170ms、勉强进 200ms；换到 4096 prefill 翻到 100ms+，总和逼近或超预算；8192 直接爆。所以窗口大小要绑死延迟预算来算，prefill 是最敏感的一项。
why_en: Summed at 2048 it's ~130-170ms, barely fitting 200ms; at 4096 prefill jumps to 100ms+ and the total nears or exceeds budget; 8192 blows it — so window size must be computed against the latency budget, with prefill the most sensitive term.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  N["网络 ~20ms"] --> A["装配 ~10ms"] --> P["prefill 60ms@2048"] --> D["解码 40-80ms"] --> T["合计 <200ms"]
options: 网络往返才是唯一的瓶颈，只要把 IDE↔服务这 20ms 优化掉就能随便把窗口开大
各项耗时都很小、余量充足，窗口可以放心从 2048 开到 8192
这份拆解只是拿来考背诵的数字，没有能落地的设计含义
options_en: At 2048 the terms sum to roughly 130-170ms and barely fit; 4096 gets close and 8192 blows the budget.
The network round-trip is the only real bottleneck; optimize away the 20ms IDE-to-service hop and the window can be opened as wide as you like.
Every term is small with plenty of slack, so the window can safely go from 2048 up to 8192.
This breakdown is just numbers to memorize, with no design meaning to act on.

termDefinitions.meaning: 逐个生成输出 token 的阶段，多 token 建议时耗时随长度增加。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Token decoding generates output tokens one by one; multi-token suggestions cost more as length grows.

optionExplanations: 对；把四项加总看总量而非单项，才能看出 4096 已逼近预算、8192 直接爆，prefill 是拖累大头。
网络只占 20ms，就算压到 0 也救不了 4096/8192 时 prefill 单项破百的超支。
@2048 时总和已到 130-170ms，逼近 200ms 上限，谈不上大量余量。
这份拆解直接给出窗口该停在哪、哪项最敏感，是设计取舍的依据，不是背诵项。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — summing all four terms (not just one) shows 4096 already nears budget and 8192 blows it, with prefill the biggest drag.
The network is only 20ms; even cutting it to 0 can't save the 100ms+ prefill overrun at 4096/8192.
At 2048 the total is already 130-170ms, close to the 200ms ceiling — hardly plenty of slack.
The breakdown directly tells you where to cap the window and which term is most sensitive — a design input, not a fact to memorize.

scenario: 候选人提议直接上 16K/32K 上下文窗口，却完全没算 prefill 延迟。
scenario_en: A candidate proposes a 16K/32K context window without accounting for prefill latency at all.
q: 「提议 16K/32K 窗口但不算 prefill」暴露了什么问题？
q_en: What does 'proposing 16K/32K without accounting for prefill' expose?
why: prefill 随长度二次增长，16K/32K 的 prefill 远超整个 200ms 预算，窗口再大也来不及出建议。讲上下文大小必须同时报延迟预算。
why_en: It exposes a production-awareness gap: prefill grows quadratically, so 16K/32K prefill far exceeds the entire 200ms budget and no window is fast enough to suggest in time — always tie context size to the latency budget, not just how much you can stuff.
options: 没问题，窗口越大能看到的仓库上下文越多，面试官会加分
暴露生产延迟意识缺口：prefill 二次增长，窗口没绑预算
只是多占显存，KV cache 变大而已，端到端延迟基本不受影响
说明该换算力更强的 GPU，硬件升级就能覆盖这个窗口
options_en: No problem — a bigger window sees more repo context, and the interviewer will give credit.
It exposes a production-latency blind spot: prefill grows quadratically and the window was never tied to the budget.
It only costs memory: the KV cache gets bigger, but end-to-end latency is basically unaffected.
It means you should move to a more powerful GPU; a hardware upgrade covers that window.
optionExplanations: 面试官恰恰会因此扣分：不算 prefill 就提大窗口说明不了解生产延迟约束。
对；大窗口的 prefill 二次爆炸会超预算，讲上下文必须同时讲它对延迟的代价。
16K/32K 不只是费显存，prefill 直接吃爆延迟预算，是延迟问题不是内存问题。
换 GPU 提不了逐次 prefill 的二次代价，问题在窗口大小与预算不匹配。
optionExplanations_en: Interviewers actually dock points: proposing a big window without prefill shows ignorance of production latency constraints.
Correct — a big window's quadratic prefill blows the budget, so discussing context must include its latency cost.
16K/32K isn't just memory; prefill directly blows the latency budget — a latency, not memory, problem.
A bigger GPU doesn't remove the quadratic prefill cost; the issue is window size mismatched to budget.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在方案里体现出对真实延迟、成本、可靠性约束的理解，而非只谈理论能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Production-awareness is showing understanding of real latency, cost, and reliability constraints, not just theoretical capability.

scenario: 一个代码仓里有几百个相关的工具函数、类型、API，连 4096 窗口都塞不下，扩大窗口又会撑爆延迟预算。
scenario_en: A repo has hundreds of relevant utility functions, types, and APIs that won't fit even a 4096 window, and enlarging it breaks the latency budget.
q: 为什么代码补全要引入检索增强(RAG)，而不是一味扩大窗口？
q_en: Why bring in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) rather than just enlarging the window?
why: 仓库相关代码远超任何可用窗口，靠扩窗口装全部会撑爆 prefill 延迟。RAG 换个思路：在推理时按当前光标上下文检索出最相关的少量片段注入提示，用检索的相关性替代窗口的容量，既拿到仓库知识又不超预算。
why_en: Repo-relevant code far exceeds any usable window, and enlarging to hold it all blows prefill latency, so RAG flips it: at inference, retrieve a few most-relevant snippets by the cursor context and inject them, using retrieval relevance instead of window capacity to get repo knowledge within budget.
options: 把窗口开到 128K，把整个仓库的相关文件全塞进去
把整个仓库继续预训练进模型参数，每次改代码再训一次
放弃仓库知识，只用光标附近这一个文件的代码补全
RAG：推理时按光标上下文检索少量最相关片段注入提示
options_en: Open the window to 128K and stuff every related repo file in.
Keep pre-training the whole repo into the model parameters and retrain on every code change.
Give up repo knowledge and complete from only the single file around the cursor.
RAG: at inference, retrieve a few most-relevant snippets by cursor context and inject them into the prompt.
optionExplanations: 128K 窗口的 prefill 二次爆炸，远超 200ms 预算，塞得下也来不及。
把仓库预训练进参数既慢又滞后，代码天天变，不可能每次改动都重训。
放弃仓库知识会让补全不懂内部函数/私有 API，质量和相关性都差。
对；RAG 用推理时检索的高相关片段替代盲目扩窗口，是仓库知识与延迟预算兼得的正解。
optionExplanations_en: A 128K window quadratically explodes prefill far past the 200ms budget — it fits but is too late.
Pre-training the repo into parameters is slow and stale; code changes daily and can't be retrained each edit.
Dropping repo knowledge leaves completion ignorant of internal functions/private APIs, hurting quality and relevance.
Correct — RAG uses inference-time high-relevance snippets instead of blind window growth, getting repo knowledge within budget.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索增强生成：推理时检索相关代码片段注入提示，补足模型没有的仓库知识。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) retrieves relevant code snippets at inference and injects them, supplying repo knowledge the model lacks.

scenario: 代码补全的检索增强(RAG)流水线与提示构造并行跑，从光标上下文一路到注入提示。
scenario_en: The code-completion RAG pipeline runs in parallel with prompt construction, from cursor context to prompt injection.
q: 把代码补全的检索增强(RAG)流水线排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the code-completion RAG pipeline correctly:
steps: 向量数据库查询：在预建索引里按余弦相似度取 top-k(~10-30ms)
把光标上下文编码成稠密向量(轻量编码器)
把重排后的片段前置注入 FIM 提示(在剩余 token 预算内)
重排：用 cross-encoder/轻量打分器过滤半相关片段、提升有用片段
why: 先把光标上下文编码成向量→在向量库按余弦取 top-k→重排过滤掉半相关的、把真正有用的提上来→把重排后的片段注入 FIM 提示。整条流水线与提示构造并行跑，不占额外串行时间。
why_en: Encode cursor context into a vector → query the vector DB top-k by cosine → rerank to drop semi-relevant and promote useful → inject the reranked snippets into the FIM prompt; the whole pipeline runs in parallel with prompt construction, adding no serial time.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  E["编码光标上下文"] --> Q["向量库 top-k"] --> RR["重排过滤"] --> INJ["注入 FIM 提示"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 按相似度取排名最高的 k 个候选片段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-k takes the k highest-similarity candidate snippets.

termDefinitions.meaning: 填中间提示：给模型光标前 prefix 和光标后 suffix，检索片段前置注入其中。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIM (Fill-In-the-Middle) prompts the model with the prefix and suffix around the cursor, with retrieved snippets prepended.

scenario: 向量检索按余弦相似度返回的是「近似匹配」，里面混着一堆只是松散相关的代码片段。
scenario_en: Vector retrieval by cosine similarity returns approximate matches, mixing in many loosely-related code snippets.
q: 检索到片段后为什么必须再做一步重排？
q_en: Why must you rerank after retrieving snippets?
why: 原始向量相似度只保证近似，直接注入会让窗口塞满松散相关的代码→模型注意力被噪声稀释→补全质量下降。重排用更精的打分把半相关的滤掉、把真正有用的提上来，保证注入的都是高相关片段。
why_en: Raw vector similarity is only approximate, so injecting it directly fills the window with loosely-related code → the model's attention is diluted by noise → completion quality drops; reranking uses a finer scorer to filter semi-relevant and promote truly useful ones so only high-relevance snippets are injected.
tradeoff: 重排(滤噪保质量但多一步计算) vs 直接注入(省一步但噪声稀释注意力)
whenOtherWins: 若检索本身极准、候选几乎全相关(小而干净的索引)，重排收益小可省；但仓库级检索一般都需要重排。
options: 向量相似度只是近似：不重排会让噪声片段稀释模型注意力
重排是为了把片段拼得更长，给模型更多上下文
重排只是给片段排个好看的顺序，对补全质量没有影响
不需要重排，余弦相似度 top-k 已经是最优结果
options_en: Vector similarity is only approximate: without reranking, noisy snippets dilute the model’s attention.
Reranking exists to stitch snippets longer and give the model more context.
Reranking just puts snippets in a nicer order and has no effect on completion quality.
No reranking is needed; cosine-similarity top-k is already the optimal result.
optionExplanations: 对；向量检索是近似的，重排是把半相关滤掉、真正有用的提上来的精度过滤，直接决定注入质量。
重排是按相关性打分筛选，不改变片段长度，答非所问。
重排不是排好看，而是提纯相关性，直接影响模型看到的是信号还是噪声。
余弦相似度只近似，混着大量松散相关片段，远非完美，正需重排收敛。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — vector retrieval is approximate, and reranking is the precision filter that drops semi-relevant and promotes useful ones, directly setting injection quality.
Reranking scores and filters by relevance and doesn't change snippet length — off point.
Reranking isn't cosmetic ordering but relevance purification, deciding whether the model sees signal or noise.
Cosine similarity is only approximate and mixes many loosely-related snippets, far from perfect, so reranking is needed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在向量检索的近似候选上用更精的打分器筛选，滤掉半相关、提升高相关片段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Re-ranking applies a finer scorer over the approximate vector candidates to drop semi-relevant and promote high-relevance snippets.

scenario: 为省一步延迟，团队跳过重排，直接把向量检索的 top-k 片段注入提示。
scenario_en: To save a step of latency, a team skips reranking and injects the top-k vector-retrieval snippets straight into the prompt.
q: 跳过重排、直接注入向量检索结果，后果是什么？
q_en: What happens if you skip reranking and inject raw vector-retrieval results?
why: 向量检索给的是半相关近似匹配→不重排就把这些噪声片段一起塞进窗口→模型注意力被松散相关代码稀释→补全质量下降。省的那点延迟远抵不过质量损失，重排是关键一环。
why_en: Vector retrieval gives semi-relevant approximate matches → without reranking these noise snippets enter the window → the model's attention is diluted by loosely-related code → completion quality drops, and the saved latency is far outweighed by the quality loss, so reranking is a key step.
options: 没有后果，少一步重排只会更快，质量不变
只增加显存占用和 KV cache，补全质量不受影响
半相关片段进窗口→注意力被噪声稀释→补全质量下降
模型会因为上下文冲突直接拒绝生成补全
options_en: No consequence; dropping one rerank step only makes it faster with unchanged quality.
It only raises memory use and KV cache size; completion quality is unaffected.
Semi-relevant snippets enter the window, attention is diluted by noise, and completion quality drops.
The model hits conflicting context and simply refuses to generate a completion.
optionExplanations: 省一步是更快，但注入的是噪声片段，质量下降，整体反而更糟。
问题不在显存而在质量：噪声片段稀释注意力，补全会明显变差。
对；跳过重排等于把近似检索的噪声直接喂模型，注意力被稀释、质量下滑，得不偿失。
模型不会拒绝生成，而是被噪声带偏生成质量更差的补全。
optionExplanations_en: Skipping a step is faster, but injecting noise snippets lowers quality, so it's worse overall.
The issue isn't memory but quality: noise snippets dilute attention and completion degrades.
Correct — skipping reranking feeds approximate-retrieval noise to the model, diluting attention and lowering quality — not worth it.
The model doesn't refuse; it's misled by noise into worse completions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 窗口里混入无关内容，分散模型注意力，削弱它对真正相关代码的利用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Attention dilution is when irrelevant content in the window scatters the model's attention, weakening its use of truly relevant code.

scenario: 向量库查询约 10-30ms，而总预算只有 200ms；如果检索索引部署在远端，网络往返会再吃掉一大块预算。
scenario_en: Vector-DB queries take ~10-30ms while the total budget is 200ms, and a remote index adds network round-trips that eat more of it.
q: 这个 10-30ms 的查询延迟对检索索引的部署有什么要求？
q_en: What does the 10-30ms query latency require of index deployment?
why: 查询本身 10-30ms 已经不小，再叠加远端网络往返就会吃掉 200ms 里太多。所以要把检索索引和推理服务同机部署(co-locate)，把查询压在 <30ms；远端索引的网络开销在这个预算下负担不起。
why_en: The query alone is 10-30ms, and adding remote network round-trips eats too much of 200ms, so co-locate the retrieval index with the serving so the lookup stays <30ms; a remote index's network overhead is unaffordable under this budget.
options: 索引部署在哪都行，10-30ms 相对 200ms 预算可以直接忽略
索引与推理服务同机部署(co-locate)，把查询压在 <30ms
索引部署得越集中越好，多团队共享一份远端索引最省运维
10-30ms 只是拿来考背诵的数字，没有能落地的设计含义
options_en: It does not matter where the index sits; 10-30ms against a 200ms budget can simply be ignored.
Co-locate the index with the serving host to keep lookups under 30ms.
The more centralized the index the better; one shared remote index across teams is cheapest to operate.
The 10-30ms figure is just a number to memorize, with no design meaning to act on.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把检索索引和推理服务部署在一起，避免跨网络往返吃掉延迟预算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Co-location places the retrieval index with the serving to avoid cross-network round-trips eating the latency budget.

optionExplanations: 10-30ms 已占 200ms 预算的一大块，叠加远端网络往返会更吃紧，不能当作可忽略。
对；把索引放到推理服务同机，查询才能稳在 <30ms，跨网络的远端索引在这预算下付不起。
集中共享省运维，但索引越远网络往返越长，会跟同机部署的延迟目标正面冲突。
这个数字直接决定了索引该不该同机部署，是设计约束的依据，不是背诵项。
optionExplanations_en: At 10-30ms it already eats a good chunk of the 200ms budget, and adding remote round-trips makes it worse — not negligible.
Correct — co-locating the index with serving keeps lookup steady under <30ms; a cross-network remote index can't afford this budget.
Sharing is convenient, but a farther index means longer round-trips, directly fighting the co-location latency goal.
This number is exactly what decides whether the index must be co-located — a design constraint, not a fact to memorize.

scenario: 把整个仓库的代码集中进一个向量库做检索，本身就是数据泄露风险——检索可能把某用户无权访问的代码片段返回给他。
scenario_en: Centralizing all repo code in one vector DB is itself a leakage risk — retrieval could surface a snippet a user isn't authorized to see.
q: 代码检索索引怎么防止越权泄露？
q_en: How does the code retrieval index prevent unauthorized leakage?
why: 检索必须强制和源文件相同的 ACL：每个片段带上其源文件的访问控制，检索期按用户权限过滤，受限代码不会浮现给无权用户。集中存储不等于集中可读，权限要在检索层落地。
why_en: Retrieval must enforce the same ACLs as the source files: each snippet carries its source file's access control, and retrieval filters by the user's permissions so restricted code never surfaces to unauthorized users — centralized storage isn't centralized readability, and permissions land at the retrieval layer.
tradeoff: 检索层强制 ACL(防越权泄露但要维护权限元数据) vs 不过滤(简单但集中存储放大泄露面)
whenOtherWins: 若整个仓库对所有用户都完全公开(如开源单仓)，没有权限边界，ACL 过滤就不是必需。
options: 进了向量库就默认全员可读，权限只在打开文件时校验
靠 IDE 前端把用户无权访问的片段隐藏起来，后端索引本身不做任何过滤
检索强制与源文件相同的 ACL，检索期按用户权限过滤片段
把所有含敏感代码的仓库整个排除在检索索引之外
options_en: Once it is in the vector store everyone can read it; permissions are checked only when opening a file.
Hide snippets the user isn't authorized for in the IDE frontend, while the backend index itself does no filtering at all.
Retrieval enforces the same ACLs as the source files, filtering snippets by user permission at query time.
Exclude every repo containing sensitive code from the retrieval index entirely.
optionExplanations: 只在打开文件时校验挡不住检索：片段绕过文件入口就进了别人的补全上下文。
只靠前端隐藏形同虚设，后端能检索到的就可能泄露，权限必须在检索层强制。
对；给片段带上源文件 ACL、检索期按权限过滤，是防越权泄露的正确落点。
整个排除敏感仓库会丢失其补全能力，正解是过滤而非一刀切排除。
optionExplanations_en: Checking only at file-open does not stop retrieval: snippets bypass the file entry point and land in someone else’s completion context.
Frontend hiding alone is hollow; whatever the backend can retrieve may leak, so permissions must be enforced at retrieval.
Correct — carrying source-file ACLs on snippets and filtering by permission at retrieval is the right place to prevent leakage.
Excluding sensitive repos entirely loses their completion value; the fix is filtering, not blanket exclusion.

termDefinitions.meaning: 访问控制列表：规定谁能访问某文件/片段，检索期据此过滤越权内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ACL (Access Control List) specifies who may access a file/snippet, used at retrieval to filter unauthorized content.

scenario: 想要比「检索期一刀切 ACL 过滤」更细粒度的权限控制，让每一步工具调用都尊重权限边界。
scenario_en: You want finer-grained permission control than blanket retrieval-time ACL filtering, respecting boundaries at each tool call.
q: 追求更细粒度的权限控制，可以用什么架构，代价是什么？
q_en: For finer-grained permission control, what architecture, and at what cost?
why: 用基于 agent 的架构：让 tool-calling 的 agent 在每一步调用时各自尊重权限边界，能做到比静态 ACL 过滤更细的、按步骤的访问控制。代价是复杂度显著更高——多了编排、工具接口和每步的权限校验。
why_en: Use an agent-based architecture: tool-calling agents respect permission boundaries at each step, giving finer per-step access control than static ACL filtering, at the cost of significantly higher complexity — added orchestration, tool interfaces, and per-step permission checks.
tradeoff: agent 架构(逐步细粒度权限但复杂度高) vs 静态 ACL 过滤(简单但粒度粗)
whenOtherWins: 若静态的检索期 ACL 过滤已满足合规、权限模型不复杂，就没必要上 agent 架构的额外复杂度。
options: agent 架构：每步工具调用各自校验权限，代价是复杂度高
退回仓库级粗粒度权限过滤，牺牲逐步控制换取更低延迟开销
把所有内部代码设为全员可读，用审计日志事后追责
用更大的模型让它自己学出该不该返回某段代码
options_en: An agent architecture: each tool call checks permissions itself, at the cost of higher complexity.
Fall back to repo-level coarse permission filtering, trading per-step control for lower latency overhead.
Make all internal code readable by everyone and rely on audit logs to assign blame afterwards.
Use a bigger model and let it learn on its own whether a snippet should be returned.
optionExplanations: 对；agent 按步校验权限能做到比静态过滤更细的控制，但要付出编排和每步校验的复杂度。
粗粒度只按仓库放行，同一仓库里的受限文件照样会被检索到，做不到逐步控制。
事后审计不阻止泄露：受限代码已经进了别人的补全上下文，追责也收不回来。
权限是硬性访问规则，靠模型学不可靠，必须由确定性的授权机制执行。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — per-step permission checks by agents give finer control than static filtering, at the cost of orchestration and per-step checks.
Coarse repo-level allow-listing still lets restricted files inside the same repo be retrieved, so per-step control is impossible.
After-the-fact auditing does not prevent leakage: the restricted code is already in someone’s completion context.
Permissions are hard access rules; learning them via a model is unreliable and must be enforced by deterministic authorization.

termDefinitions.term: tool-calling agent / 工具调用智能体
termDefinitions.meaning: 能按步骤调用外部工具/数据、并在每步遵守权限边界的 LLM 智能体。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tool-calling agent is an LLM agent that invokes external tools/data step by step while respecting permission boundaries at each step.

scenario: 面试官想听你说清「基座模型、上下文窗口、检索」这三个决策不是各自独立的。
scenario_en: The interviewer wants you to show that base model, context window, and retrieval are not independent decisions.
q: 这三个决策为什么互相牵制，举个例子？
q_en: Why are the three decisions interdependent — give an example?
why: 三者共享同一个 200ms 预算：选更大的模型→推理更慢→留给检索和上下文装配的预算被压缩→只能用更小窗口或更少检索。反过来，更小模型+RAG 能在仓库专属代码上追平甚至超过更大模型，因为检索补上了小模型缺的领域知识。
why_en: They share one 200ms budget: a bigger model → slower inference → less budget for retrieval and context assembly → a smaller window or less retrieval; conversely, a smaller model + RAG can match or beat a bigger model on repo-specific code because retrieval supplies the domain knowledge the small model lacks.
options: 三个决策完全独立，可以分别取最优再拼装在一起
只有模型大小这一个维度重要，上下文窗口和检索策略怎么设都不影响延迟预算
三者互不相关，推理预算可以按需扩容所以不存在竞争
三者共享 200ms 预算：模型选大了，留给检索和装配的就少
options_en: The three decisions are fully independent and can be optimized separately then bolted together.
Only model size matters as a dimension; however you set the context window and retrieval strategy, the latency budget is unaffected.
They are unrelated; inference budget can be scaled on demand so there is no competition.
They share one 200ms budget: pick a bigger model and less is left for retrieval and context assembly.
optionExplanations: 分开各自最优会忽略共享预算，大模型选定后窗口和检索的空间就被挤没了。
只顾模型大小会让窗口/检索被动缩水，三者是一盘棋不是一个旋钮。
预算恰恰只有 200ms 且共享，正是这个约束让三者互相牵制。
对；面试官要听的正是每个选择如何在共享预算里约束并赋能其它选择，这才是系统性推理。
optionExplanations_en: Optimizing separately ignores the shared budget; once a big model is chosen, window and retrieval room are squeezed out.
Focusing only on size passively shrinks window/retrieval; the three are one board, not one knob.
The budget is exactly 200ms and shared, and that constraint is what makes them interdependent.
Correct — interviewers want how each choice constrains and enables the others within the shared budget, the systemic reasoning.

termDefinitions.term: interdependent decisions / 相互依赖的决策
termDefinitions.meaning: 共享同一资源预算的多个设计选择，一个变动会挤压或松绑其它选择。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Interdependent decisions share one resource budget, so changing one squeezes or frees the others.

scenario: 在仓库专属代码补全上，要在「更大的通用模型」和「更小模型 + RAG」之间选。
scenario_en: For repo-specific code completion, choose between a larger general model and a smaller model + RAG.
q: 为什么更小的模型加检索，能在仓库专属代码上追平甚至超过更大的模型？
q_en: Why can a smaller model plus retrieval match or beat a larger model on repo-specific code?
why: 仓库专属知识(内部函数、私有 API)不在任何模型的预训练里，大模型也不会；而 RAG 在推理时把仓库里真实的相关片段检索进来，直接把领域知识喂给小模型。所以小模型+RAG 在仓库代码上能追平/超过纯大模型，还更快更省。
why_en: Repo-specific knowledge (internal functions, private APIs) isn't in any model's pretraining, not even a big one's, but RAG retrieves the repo's real relevant snippets at inference and feeds the domain knowledge to the small model, so small model + RAG matches or beats a pure big model on repo code, faster and cheaper.
tradeoff: 小模型+RAG(仓库知识靠检索补、快省) vs 大模型无检索(通用强但不懂私有仓库)
whenOtherWins: 若任务考的是通用算法/语言能力、跟具体仓库无关，大模型更强的推理反而更占优，RAG 帮不上多少。
options: 不可能，参数量越大的模型在任何代码上都一定更强
仓库私有知识不在任何预训练里，RAG 推理时把真实片段喂进来
因为小模型天生更懂代码结构，大模型被自然语言稀释
因为 RAG 相当于给模型直接增加了参数量，等效于训练了一个更大模型
options_en: Impossible; a model with more parameters is always stronger on any code.
Repo-private knowledge is in no pretraining corpus, and RAG feeds real snippets in at inference time.
Because small models inherently understand code structure better, while big models are diluted by natural language.
Because RAG effectively adds parameters to the model directly, equivalent to training a bigger model.

why_en: FIM = Fill-In-the-Middle: give the model both the prefix before and suffix after the cursor so it completes the missing middle; completion is inherently middle-filling, not pure continuation, so use the FIM format, with retrieved snippets prepended into it.
